transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded. May I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Rohan. I wanted to inquire about an interior project for my parents.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Rohan! Whose home or space are we designing—their apartment, villa, or an independent house?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's a 3BHK apartment in Hadapsar—new possession.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That sounds wonderful! Could you share the PIN code for the area in Hadapsar, just so we can confirm we cover your location and match you with a nearby designer?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. Roughly what is the carpet area, and when are you hoping to have the work completed?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Not entirely sure of the exact carpet area, maybe around 1200 square feet. As for when, they just got the keys, so whenever it makes sense—no strict rush, but soon-ish.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Do you have a rough budget in mind? It's fine if not.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Not really sure about the exact budget yet, we just want a proper design for them.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Would Thursday at 2 pm or Saturday at 10 am work best for a consultation with one of our designers?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's booked for Saturday, 10 October at 10 am, and you'll receive an SMS confirmation shortly.
